g.text: Containerized Single-Node Distributed Runtime • HDFS Storage Pipelines • YARN Compute Orchestration • Multi-Platform Deployments
make up • docker compose up -d • launchers/windows/Start-Hadoop-Docker.bat
Kali Linux 2026.2 • Hadoop 3.3.6 • 6GB RAM / 4 vCPUs tuned
Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 • 4 vCPUs • Dynamic RAM • UEFI CA • NAT fix
Windows 11 Native Kernel • xRDP Port 3390 • Zero VM overhead
PowerShell automated NAT port-forwarding & VM provisioning
Native Windows Host interfaces connecting into Docker
Direct HTTP administrative visibility into daemons:
Boots cluster, tests engine, opens logs
Run full HDFS & YARN test suite
Zero-setup real data located in datasets/:
Large corpus text for MapReduce WordCount
Structured records for PySpark DataFrame jobs
CLI script, or PySpark code. Commands route to
IMAGE: ubuntu:20.04 | RUNTIME: OpenJDK 8 JRE | USER: hduser:hadoop (UID 1000) | SSHD: Port 22 -> 22222
Holds entire HDFS directory structure, file-to-block mapping, permissions
Periodically pulls fsimage and accumulated edits via HTTP, merges them in RAM
into a compact, fresh checkpoint image, then ships it back to NameNode.
Pull [fsimage + edits] ➔ Merge in Memory ➔ Push [fsimage.ckpt] ➔ Truncate Edits
Physical Distributed Block Storage & Integrity Verification
• Heartbeat (3s): Reports node liveness & storage utilization. • Block Report (6h): Sends inventory of all raw block IDs.
SecondaryNameNode merges transactions every 3600 seconds or 1,000,000 operations.
Ensures NameNode restarts in seconds without replaying gigabytes of edit logs.
• Pure scheduler: does not monitor status
Reports CPU vCores & physical memory utilization to RM every 1,000 ms via IPC.
Historical Metrics, Log Aggregation & Audit Trail
Collects finished application metrics, task counters, timeline data, and container logs
even after ApplicationMaster and worker containers terminate.
ResourceManager evaluates available cluster memory, spawns ApplicationMaster container,
then schedules map/reduce tasks prioritizing Data Locality (NODE_LOCAL).
• Mapper containers execute code on local HDFS blocks.
• Intermediate key-values partitioned and sorted in memory.
• Network shuffle routes partitions to Reducer tasks.
Reducers write final part-r-00000 back to HDFS DataNode.
Zero Data Loss: All cluster state safely survives container restarts and image updates
Stores filesystem namespace tree, fsimage snapshots, and edits logs
Stores actual raw 128MB replicated data blocks (blk_* and blk_*.meta checksums)
MapReduce spill buffers, intermediate shuffle files, and localized JAR tokens
Daemon stdout/stderr logs for NameNode, DataNode, RM, NM, and JHS
• HDFS Block Size: 128 MB default | Replication Factor: 1 (Single-Node Dev) | YARN Memory: 4096 MB allocation | JVM Flags: -XX:+UseG1GC -Xms1024m -Xmx2048m
